# AstryxMetadataList { #anylumino.AstryxMetadataList }

```python
AstryxMetadataList(items, **props)
```

Render label-value metadata rows.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name    | Type                            | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | Default    |
|---------|---------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| items   | Iterable\[Mapping\[str, Any\]\] | Item records used by generated child components or static search sources.                                                                                                                                                                             | _required_ |
| **props | Any                             | JSON-safe MetadataList props. Useful keys: columns, label, maxNumOfItems, orientation, title, className, and style. anylumino generates metadata children from items. See Astryx component docs: <https://astryx.atmeta.com/components/MetadataList>. | `{}`       |
